items.statement: Project leads assess project risk and propose mitigation, while the management representative owns and monitors the documented process.

evidence_quotes.quote_original: Predstavnik direktora za nadzor SUK-a je vlasnik procesa i odgovoran je za nadzor provedbe opisanog procesa te održavanje dokumentiranog postupka.

items.statement: The risk-management process systematically identifies, analyzes, evaluates, and treats risks affecting Enconet projects and services.

sources.source_locator: 5. Odgovornosti and 6.1 Proces upravljanja rizicima, pages 4-5, lines 100-157

evidence_quotes.quote_original: Postupak ocjene (procjene, assessment) se izvodi po slijedećim fazama:

items.statement: Each project is screened for applicable risk categories and critical conditions requiring detailed assessment.

evidence_quotes.quote_original: Za svaki projekt potrebno je procijeniti koje kategorije rizika su primjerene i stoga ih je potrebno detaljno analizirati i evaluirati.

items.statement: Risk treatment defines mitigation or elimination actions according to the severity of potential consequences.

evidence_quotes.quote_original: Obzirom na nivo i ozbiljnost posljedica rizika, tablica 5. Obrada (treatment) rizika određuje akcije u smislu ublažavanja ili, ukoliko je to moguće, otklanjanja rizika, koji može biti visoki, srednji ili niski.

items.statement: The process owner archives risk-assessment and treatment results as quality records.
